hero: New area? Meals you can cook this week with the market down the street.
healthLine: General info, not medical advice. Food allergies, diabetes, special diets, ongoing tiredness, weight changes, or any illness that worries you: contact your mission nurse. Diarrhea for more than 3 days, or with blood or a fever over 102 F: contact your nurse now (CDC).
waterLine: Follow your mission's water guidance first.

approvalLine: Use only if apps like this are approved for your mission. Ask your mission leaders.
storageLine: Your area and kitchen setup are saved only on this phone. The phone may clear the saved area if the app goes unused for a while; just pick it again.
kitchenDefault: Recipes assume one pot, one pan, two burners, no fridge.
